interpretation: Fixed-protocol rolling re-evaluation on previously exposed dates; day-block intervals treat days as independent although participants/pairs repeat, so they are descriptive of day-to-day variation, not population inference.

base_protocol.threshold: maximum validation F1; ties closest to0.5

protocol.exposure: All candidate test dates were scored earlier as T17 test, T22 walk-forward or T21/T22 primary test; this is a fixed-protocol re-evaluation with more test days, not a pristine holdout.
protocol.fit_failure: drop that fold for every model and window
protocol.fold_selection: every cohort time satisfying the rules; fixed before fitting
protocol.purge: every train/validation t+24h strictly before the next set's first t

ranking.unit: (prediction time, participant) with >=1 positive reliably labeled candidate

protocol.unknown_labels: excluded upstream by the frozen cohort; never zero
